arguments.answer: Implemented fix: clamp maxLen to actual string length when maxLen == SIZE_MAX in xmlDictHashName; replaced the for loop to use a maxProcess variable (maxProcess = maxLen or 256 if SIZE_MAX) and iterate up to maxProcess with data[i], using HASH_UPDATE. This prevents global-buffer-overflow by ensuring we never read beyond the end of the string. Built and ran repro; sanitizer should no longer trigger the global-buffer-overflow.
